title: Monetary Policy Radar: Fed and BoJ Head for More Tightening
title_zh: 央行雷達：Fed 與日銀都朝進一步緊縮前進
subtitle: 央行雷達：Fed 與日銀都朝進一步緊縮前進
author: Financial Times

sentences.en: October inflation data keeps BoJ on course for further tightening.
sentences.zh: 10 月通膨數據讓日銀維持在進一步緊縮的路徑上。

sentences.en: Headline price pressures accelerated as government fuel and energy subsidies were phased out.
sentences.zh: 隨著政府的燃料與能源補貼逐步取消，整體物價壓力加速上升。

sentences.en: The BoJ has long signalled that it is set to raise rates again at its December meeting as it seeks to accelerate the pace of normalisation.
sentences.zh: 日銀一直以來都暗示，將在 12 月會議上再度升息，以加快（貨幣政策）正常化的步調。

sentences.en: Fed’s October minutes confirm December increase and float faster tightening.
sentences.zh: Fed 的 10 月會議紀錄確認 12 月將升息，並提出加快緊縮的可能。

vocab.usage: monetary tightening 貨幣緊縮；反義 easing 寬鬆；動詞 tighten
vocab.example: Further tightening could slow the economy.
vocab.example_zh: 進一步緊縮可能讓經濟放緩。

vocab.usage: on course for / to do… 朝…前進；＝on track
vocab.example: The project is on course for completion in May.
vocab.example_zh: 這個專案預計五月完成。

vocab.usage: government subsidies 政府補貼；動詞 subsidize
vocab.example: The government offers subsidies for solar panels.
vocab.example_zh: 政府對太陽能板提供補貼。

vocab.usage: phase out + 名詞；反義 phase in 逐步實施
vocab.example: The company will phase out paper invoices.
vocab.example_zh: 公司將逐步取消紙本發票。

vocab.usage: signal that…；英式拼法過去式 signalled，美式 signaled
vocab.example: The CEO signaled that prices may rise.
vocab.example_zh: 執行長暗示價格可能上漲。

vocab.usage: 美式 normalization；policy normalization 政策正常化（退出超寬鬆）
反義 hawkish 鷹派的（偏向緊縮、升息）；doves and hawks
固定複數；take the minutes 做會議紀錄（TOEIC 常見）
vocab.example: Could you take the minutes at today's meeting?
vocab.example_zh: 你可以負責今天會議的紀錄嗎？

vocab.usage: cast doubt on / as to whether… 使人懷疑…
vocab.example: The report cast doubt on the plan.
vocab.example_zh: 這份報告讓人對計畫產生懷疑。

vocab.usage: demonstrate that…；product demonstration 產品示範（demo）
confirm a reservation 確認訂位（TOEIC 必考）；名詞 confirmation
vocab.example: Please confirm your reservation by email.
vocab.example_zh: 請以電子郵件確認您的預約。

vocab.usage: float an idea 提出一個想法；也指貨幣「浮動」
vocab.example: She floated the idea of working from home.
vocab.example_zh: 她提出在家工作的想法。

vocab.usage: shift to / toward…；名詞 a shift in focus 焦點轉移；night shift 夜班
vocab.example: The focus has shifted to costs.

vocab.usage: voice concerns / support 表達擔憂／支持
vocab.example: Several employees voiced concerns about the plan.
vocab.example_zh: 幾位員工對計畫表達了擔憂。

vocab.example: He joined in May and was subsequently promoted.
vocab.example_zh: 他五月加入，後來獲得升遷。
